name: neuro-chimera-synth
title: CHIMERA // LAB — Bio-Digital SQL Synthesizer & Kiro Crew Agent Hive
description: Flagship Website #4: a Physarum slime-mould simulation of your database traffic. Full-table scans and N+1 loops glow crimson; sever or drag nodes and the network re-routes. A deterministic SQL parser and cost planner compare EXPLAIN plans before and after Kiro Crew optimization, three Kiro Crew agents ship as an installable app, and the network's health is sonified as an FM drone.
author: GenUI Studio

pages.title: CHIMERA // LAB · Bio-Digital SQL Synthesizer
pages.description: Live bio-network canvas with the SQL, Kiro Crew and sonification command deck, plus an AI research SaaS landing-page mode.

remixPresets.label: Stream Preset: Autonomous Kiro Crew Night-Shift (4 Parallel Agents Refactoring Postgres)
remixPresets.description: Loads the overnight refactor network (planner, refactor, test and review agents on one code-index database) and dispatches deadlock-hunter, index-surgeon and chimera-architect in turn.

remixPresets.description: Loads the variant-calling and protein fold search network: 850M variants without a (chrom, pos) index and 220k structures without an HNSW index.
remixPresets.prompt: Stream Preset: Biotech Genomics Pipeline & Protein Folding Telemetry

remixPresets.label: Inject Corrupted Cyclic SQL AST / NaN Chemotaxis Packet
remixPresets.description: Streams two chemotaxis packets that reference each other, with NaN and 1e308 strengths, unknown nodes and a recursive CTE payload. The core severs the cycle and heals the props; the lab quarantines the packets without changing the network.
remixPresets.prompt: Inject Corrupted Cyclic SQL AST / NaN Chemotaxis Packet
